name: flextime
label: Allow workers more flexible hours

questions.text:

A. Allow workers more flexible working hours, to handle family responsibilities.

name: feless1
label: How important men work harder explain

questions.text:
On average, women who are employed full time earn less than men earn. I'm going to read several reasons why this might be so. Please tell me how important you think each reason is: very important, important, somewhat important, or not at all important. For example,...
A. Men work harder on the job than women Do. How important do you think this reason is for explaining why women earn less?

questions.item: A. Men work harder on the job than women Do. How important do you think this reason is for explaining why women earn less?

name: feless2
label: How important women's family responsibilities

questions.text:
On average, women who are employed full time earn less than men earn. I'm going to read several reasons why this might be so. Please tell me how important you think each reason is: very important, important, somewhat important, or not at all important. For example,...

name: feless3
label: How important give men better paying jobs

questions.text:

C. Employers tend to give men better paying jobs than they give women. How important do you think this reason is for explaining why women earn less?

name: fehire
label: Should hire and promote women

questions.text:
Now I'm going to read several statements. As I read each one, please tell me whether you strongly agree, agree, neither agree nor disagree, disagree, or strongly disagree. For example, here is the statement: 
Because of past discrimination, employers should make special efforts to hire and promote qualified women.

name: layoffs
label: Who has the greatest right to keep their jobs?

questions.text: From time to time companies must lay-off some of their employees. If some have to be laid-off, who, in your opinion, has the greatest right to keep their jobs?

values.label: those who have the greatest needs
those who are the best workers
difficulty in finding a new job

name: occyrs
label: How many years in your occupation

questions.text:
How long have you been doing the kind of work you did last week (OCCUPATION DESCRIBED IN OCC )?  That is, at least how many years in your occupation? 
Please include all previous jobs of the same kind.

name: occtrain

questions.text: A. Have you gone through any specialized training in school to obtain a vocational certificate, diploma, degree, or license for this occupation?

name: trainsch
label: How many years spent on training

questions.text: B. In total, how many years have you spent (on such specialized training in school)?

name: typeorg

name: othyrs

questions.text: B. How many years in total (at those parts) have you worked?

name: partorg

questions.text: B. How long have you worked full time for those work sites? How many years?
